Therefore, the events of ''Steps Into Shadow'' must take place in [[2 BBY]]. Since the ''Phantom''{{'s}} destruction is depicted in the episode, it must have been destroyed in the same year. during the [[mission to Reklam Station]]''[[Star Wars Rebels: Steps Into Shadow]]'' |retired= |affiliation=*[[Spectres]]''[[Star Wars Rebels: Spark of Rebellion]]'' *[[Phoenix Cell]]''[[Star Wars Rebels: The Siege of Lothal]]'' |navy= |fleet= |owners= |captains= |registry= |aliases= }} {{Quote|Another great surprise the ''Ghost'' packs is the ''Phantom''. It's a starfighter that's hidden, in plain sight, on the back of the ''Ghost''.|Ezra Bridger|''[[Star Wars Rebels: A New Hero]]''}} The '''''Phantom''''' was a modified [[VCX-series auxiliary starfighter]] manufactured by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation]] that was used by the [[Spectres]] during the [[Imperial Era]] and the early conflicts of the [[Galactic Civil War]]. The ''Phantom'' could dock with its mothership, the ''[[Ghost]]''. It was widely used by the crew of the ''Ghost'', typically flown by [[Hera Syndulla]] or [[Kanan Jarrus]], but it could also be [[pilot]]ed by [[C1-10P|Chopper]] or by autopilot. The ''Phantom'' was used by the Spectres on numerous missions against the [[Galactic Empire]] before it was destroyed at [[Reklam Station]]. ==Description== [[File:Phantom_Interior.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Interior of the ''Phantom''.]] The ''Phantom'' was a modified [[VCX-series auxiliary starfighter]] that was attached to the [[VCX-100 light freighter]] known as the ''Ghost''. Both vessels were manufactured by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. The auxiliary ship was armed with a [[Taim & Bak]] [[MS-2B twin laser cannon]] and a Taim & Bak [[KX4 dorsal laser turret]] The ''Phantom'' had a former [[starfighter]] cockpit that had been sourced during an earlier raid. It was also equipped with at least four swinging seats which could be folded to make way for goods. The ''Phantom'' also had a hatch which led down to the ''Ghost''{{'s}} ship ladder.{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/rise-of-the-old-masters-concept-art-gallery|text="Rise of the Old Masters" Concept Art Gallery}} The ''Phantom'' was capable of doubling as both a starfighter and shuttle; something that was maximized by its crew. On at least two occasions, the ''Phantom'' sustained damage but was repaired to full operational capacity.{{Rebels|Out of Darkness}}{{Rebels|Relics of the Old Republic}} The ''Phantom'' was also equipped with a jammer that allowed it to conceal its presence.{{Rebels|Rise of the Old Masters}} The rebel [[Sabine Wren]] painted a [[Sando aqua monster]] on the ''Phantom''{{'s}} hull.''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]'' The ''Phantom'' was upgraded to include a [[hyperdrive]] by a [[Mon Calamari]] shipbuilder named [[Quarrie]]. However, the hyperdrive required an [[Astromech droid|astromech]] in order to function.{{Rebels|Wings of the Master}} Trivia Gallery In addition, the ''Phantom{{'s}}'' autopilot was also programmed to fly back to the mothership. This was a mechanism designed to counter thefts.{{Rebels|Brothers of the Broken Horn}} Because of the ''Phantom''{{'s}} secondary role as a shuttle, it was larger, heavier, and less agile than dedicated starfighters like the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter]] used by the Galactic Empire. This was compensated for by its durability, shielding, aft armament, versatility, and sophisticated avionics systems. In addition to its duties as a fighter and shuttle, the laser cannons allowed it to be used as an aft-facing gun turret for the ''Ghost'' when docked in reverse. ==History== ===The Spectres=== As part of ''Ghost''{{'s}} auxiliary vessel, the ''Phantom'' was owned by the [[Twi'lek]] [[pilot]] [[Hera Syndulla]]. Her crew included the former [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Kanan Jarrus]], the [[astromech droid]] [[C1-10P|Chopper]], the former [[Lasat]] [[Lasan High Honor Guard|Honor Guardsman]] [[Garazeb Orrelios]], and the teenaged [[Mandalorian]] weapons expert and artist [[Sabine Wren]]. During a raid on an Imperial convoy, Chopper manned the ''Phantom''{{'s}} [[laser cannon]]s when the mother ship was attacked by several TIE fighters.{{Rebels|The Machine in the Ghost}} During a heist on Imperial supplies on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] planet [[Lothal]], the rebels encountered a [[Force-sensitive]] [[human]] boy named [[Ezra Bridger]], who took a ride aboard the ''Ghost''. After escaping his improvised holding cell, Ezra manned one of the ''Phantom''{{'s}} laser turrets before being relieved by Sabine. Still attached to its mother ship, the ''Phantom'' took part on a mission to rescue [[Wookiee]] slaves being shipped to the [[spice]] mines of [[Kessel]]. Following these adventures, Ezra decided to become Kanan's apprentice and join the crew of the ''Ghost''. ===Further adventures===
[[File:Hera_Syndulla_Attack_Shuttle_XWM.png|thumb|250px|The ''Phantom'' and a swarm of tibidees]]
Later, the crew of the ''Ghost'' learned that the [[Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli]] was imprisoned at the [[Spire]], a high-security prison on the planet [[Stygeon Prime]]. While Chopper waited aboard the ''Ghost'', the other rebels flew down to the Spire aboard the ''Phantom''. Hera piloted the auxiliary shuttle and deployed Kanan, Ezra, Sabine, and Zeb onto a landing platform. While the other rebels entered the prison, Hera attached the ''Phantom'' to the side of the prison. To avoid detection, she powered down the auxiliary vessel and activated a jammer. Hera's companions quickly discovered that Luminara was dead and were trapped by the [[Grand Inquisitor]] and several [[stormtrooper]]s. Meanwhile, the ''Phantom''{{'s}} sensors detected something approaching the shuttle. Hera initially thought it was a TIE fighter but quickly discovered that it was a large swarm of [[tibidee]]s, which had mistaken the shuttle's jamming system for a mating call. Hera quickly detached the shuttle from the prison but was pursued by the tibidees. Later, Hera managed to win over the tibidees and use them to harass the Imperials while she rescued the other Spectres. They then flew back to the ''Ghost'' and fled into space. The ''Phantom'' and its mother ship later took part in a mission to intercept an Imperial convoy transporting a large [[kyber crystal]]. Kanan flew the ''Phantom'' while Hera piloted the ''Ghost''. The two rebels had learnt about the convoy from Ezra, who had infiltrated Lothal's [[Academy for Young Imperials]], and a [[cadet]] named [[Zare Leonis]], who was sympathetic to the rebels. While the ''Phantom'' distracted the convoy's TIE fighter escorts, the ''Ghost'' destroyed the [[Gozanti-class cruiser|''Gozanti''-class cruiser]] carrying the kyber crystal. This triggered a vast explosion which destroyed the Imperial convoy. The ''Phantom'' narrowly managed to escape the explosion by linking up with the ''Ghost'', which then jumped into hyperspace.{{Rebels|Breaking Ranks}} After a supply raid on Lothal, the ''Phantom'' was pursued by several TIE fighters and had its fuel line damaged by a [[laser]] strike while navigating through a canyon. After the mission, the ''Phantom'' and the Ghost docked with each other, Ezra, Chopper, and Zeb ran a diagnostic scan but failed to check it due to their bickering. During a supply run to [[Fort Anaxes]], an old Republic base on the asteroid [[PM-1203]] that had been abandoned some time after the [[Clone Wars]], the ruptured fuel line was discovered. Hera and Sabine were stranded on the asteroid and surrounded by several hostile [[fyrnock]]s. Their mission proved successful despite some close calls with the beasts, in part thanks to explosive [[rhydonium]] canisters. Kanan, Ezra, Chopper, and Zeb arrived in short order to rescue the two and the ''Phantom'' was recovered as well. ===Rising challenges=== [[File:Mission_to_Fort_Anaxes.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Phantom'' approaching Fort Anaxes]] After sabotaging the [[Empire Day]] celebrations in Lothal's Capital City, the rebels fled into space on the ''Ghost''. They were accompanied by the [[Rodian]] fugitive [[Tseebo]], an [[Imperial Information Office]] employee who wore a cybernetic implant containing Imperial secrets. During a brief dog fight, Chopper manned the ''Phantom''{{'s}} laser cannons but was knocked out by a laser blast. Before the Imperials could inflict further damage, Tseebo transmitted coordinates into the ''Ghost''{{'s}} hyperdrive which allowed the rebels to escape into [[hyperspace]]. However, the Grand Inquisitor succeeded in planting an [[XX-23 S-thread tracker]] onto the auxiliary vessel's hull. While traveling through hyperspace, Chopper detected the homing beacon on the ''Phantom''{{'s}} hull. To prevent the Empire from capturing Tseebo, Kanan, and Ezra decided to use the ''Phantom'' as a decoy vessel to lure the Inquisitor away from the ''Ghost''. The ''Phantom'' exited hyperspace above the asteroid PM-1203 and landed at Fort Anaxes. There, Ezra used the Force to command the fyrnocks to attack the Grand Inquisitor and his stormtroopers. After escaping the Inquisitor, Kanan and an exhausted Ezra escaped aboard the ''Phantom'' and linked up with the ''Ghost''. Since Ezra had tapped into the [[Dark side of the Force|Dark Side]] during his confrontation with the Inquisitor, Kanan decided that his Padawan should embark on his [[Jedi Trials|Jedi trials]] to ascertain whether he had the discipline to be a Jedi. While meditating with his [[Kanan Jarrus' holocron|Jedi holocron]], Kanan discovered that there was a [[Lothal Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] on Lothal. He used the ''Phantom'' to take his apprentice there. After Ezra sensed the temple's presence, Kanan landed the shuttle near the temple. After Ezra passed his Jedi trials, he and Kanan returned to the ''Ghost'' with the ''Phantom''.{{Rebels|Path of the Jedi}} The ''Phantom'' also saw action during a mission by the crew of the ''Ghost'' to seize control of the [[Imperial Communications Center]] in [[Jalath]] and use it to broadcast Rebel counter-propaganda. Hera remained aboard the ''Phantom'' to provide a get-away transport while the other rebels seized control of the facility. However, this was a trap set by [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin|Tarkin]], the Grand Inquisitor, and [[Agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus|Kallus]]. Imperial forces quickly converged on the communications tower. While Kanan held back the Imperials, the other rebels managed to escape aboard the ''Phantom''. Despite Hera's protests, she complied with Kanan's orders to leave him and escape.{{Rebels|Call to Action}} Despite Kanan's capture, Ezra succeeded in broadcasting a message before Grand Moff Tarkin destroyed the communications tower. Following Kanan's capture, Hera received orders from the mysterious rebel leader known as [[Ahsoka Tano|Fulcrum]] to sacrifice Kanan in order to avoid exposing the rebellion. However, Ezra, Sabine, Zeb, and Chopper defied Hera's orders and used the ''Phantom'' to visit the [[Devaronian]] [[crime lord]] [[Cikatro Vizago]]. With Vizago's help, the rebels learnt that Kanan was imprisoned aboard Tarkin's flagship ''[[Sovereign]]'', which was departing for the [[Mustafar system]].{{Rebels|Rebel Resolve}} ===A wider rebellion=== [[File:Kanan_Meditates.png|thumb|250px|Kanan meditating at front of the ''Phantom'']] Following [[Action at Mustafar|Kanan's rescue]], the crew of the ''Ghost'' learned that they were part of a larger rebellion. Fulcrum was an alias for the Jedi Purge survivor Ahsoka Tano, who was a key rebel leader. The rebels also joined the [[Phoenix Cell]], which operated a fleet of starships. The ''Phantom'' and its mother ship narrowly survived an [[Attack on Phoenix Squadron (4 BBY)|attack]] on the Phoenix fleet by [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]]. Following their escape, the ''Phantom'' was used by the rebels on a mission to the desert planet [[Seelos]]. Ahsoka had sent the rebels to contact an old friend from the Clone Wars, the former [[Clone Captain]] [[Rex]]. The rebels needed new bases and Ahsoka believed that Rex knew the location of several Clone Wars-era facilities. While Hera and Chopper waited above in the ''Ghost'', Kanan and the other rebels descended to Seelos on the ''Phantom''. After establishing contact with Rex and two other former Clone commanders, the ''Phantom'' was attacked and damaged by an Imperial [[probe droid]]. The rebels and clones managed to destroy the probe droid and repair the shuttle.{{Rebels|The Lost Commanders}} Shortly later, an Imperial Star Destroyer led by [[Admiral]] [[Kassius Konstantine]] and Agent Kallus arrived over Seelos. During the ensuing [[Assault on Seelos|battle]], the rebels departed on the ''Phantom'' while Rex and his comrades held back Kallus' [[All Terrain Armored Transport|AT-AT walkers]] with their [[Rex's AT-TE|antiquated]] [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer|AT-TE walker]]. At Ezra's urging, Kanan decided to help the clone veterans and used the ''Phantom'' to destroy one of the AT-AT walkers. After defeating the Imperials, the clone commanders agreed to join the Rebellion. Later, Sabine, Zeb, Chopper, and Ezra traveled on the ''Phantom'' during a mission to retrieve medical supplies from an abandoned Old Republic medical base in space. After docking the shuttle in a hangar bay, the four rebels ventured into the space station only to be ambushed by two [[Inquisitorius|Inquisitors]] known as the [[Seventh Sister]] and the [[Fifth Brother]]. The Inquisitors managed to overpower and capture Chopper, Ezra, and Sabine but Zeb managed to escape and free Chopper. Using the ''Phantom''{{'s}} intercom, he posed as "Commander Meiloorun" and tricked the Inquisitors into entering the hangar bay. Following another struggle, he managed to free the other two rebels and they escaped into space to rejoin the fleet.{{Rebels|Always Two There Are}} Following their encounter with the two Inquisitors, Ezra and Chopper used the ''Phantom'' to come to the aid of Vizago, whose ship the ''[[Broken Horn]]'' had been taken over by the [[Weequay]] pirate [[Hondo Ohnaka]]. After docking the ''Phantom'' in the ''Broken Horn''{{'s}} hangar bay, the two rebels encountered Ohnaka, who claimed that he had won the ''Broken Horn'' by beating Vizago in a [[sabacc]] game. Together, the three companions attempted to sell several power generators to the [[Jablogian]] crime lord [[Azmorigan]]. After escaping Azmorigan, Ezra and Chopper discovered a captive Vizago and freed him. During the ensuing fight between Vizago and Ohnaka, Ohnaka fled to the planet [[Garel]] on the ''Phantom''. However, the ''Phantom''{{'s}} autopilot had been programmed to fly back to its mother ship. The ''Phantom'' along with Ohnaka and the power generators were subsequently recovered by the other crew of the ''Ghost''. Ohnaka was allowed to keep his proceeds but agreed to hand over the power generators to the rebels, who used them to aid the people of [[Rinn]], which was experiencing an energy crisis. ===The hyperdrive upgrade and beyond=== [[File:Phantom_with_astromech_socket.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Phantom'' with an astromech socket]] The ''Phantom'' was later used by Hera, Sabine, and Zeb to investigate the possibility of using an experimental new starfighter being developed on the planet [[Shantipole]] to break a blockade preventing relief supplies being delivered to severely overworked laborers on the planet [[Ibaar]]. Because of atmospheric hazards, the ''Phantom'' was disabled and crash-landed on the landing pad of Quarrie's secret research and development station. Quarrie offered several parts to restore the ''Phantom'' to flight-worthiness, and also surreptitiously installed an aftermarket hyperdrive engine. The ''Phantom'' then delivered the prototype [[Prototype B6|Blade Wing]] fighter to the rebel blockade run to Ibaar using this hyperdrive. Since test-firing an experimental heavy weapon on the ''Blade Wing'' had disabled its own integrated hyperdrive, the Blade Wing had to be ferried through hyperspace by the ''Phantom''; which was now equipped with Quarrie's only other available hyperdrive engine. Thanks to the ''Phantom''{{'s}} timely delivery, the ''Blade wing'' turned the blockade run into a blockade bust. Later, the ''Phantom'' was used by Kanan, Ezra, Chopper, and Zeb to travel to [[Hammertown]], a settlement on the planet [[Takobo]]. Tano had sent the four rebels on a mission to investigate a set of coordinates belonging to the Inquisitors. Upon arriving, the rebels learnt that the Fifth Brother and Seventh Sister were kidnapping Force-sensitive babies. The rebels managed to recover two younglings, [[Alora]] and [[Pypey]]. After fighting off the Inquisitors with the help of Ahsoka, the rebels fled to Garel, which had become home to a significant rebel presence.{{Rebels|The Future of the Force}} Following the [[Battle of Garel]], Kanan, Ezra, and Chopper used the ''Phantom'' to travel to Lothal. Ezra had earlier received a [[Force vision]] of his parents [[Ephraim Bridger|Ephraim]] and [[Mira Bridger]] and decided to find them. After finding a gap in the Imperial fleet, the ''Phantom'' traveled to Lothal. After landing at [[Capital City]], Chopper stayed aboard the ''Phantom'' while Ezra searched for the [[loth-cat]] he had encountered in his vision. When the loth-cat escaped on a [[speeder bike]] into the wilderness, the three rebels used the ''Phantom'' to track to speeder bike to a remote camp. There, the three rebels encountered [[Ryder Azadi]], the former [[Governor]] of Lothal who had known Ezra's parents. Azadi revealed that Ezra's parents had died during an escape attempt which had been inspired by Ezra's recent broadcast from the Imperial Communications Center.{{Rebels|Legacy (episode)}} When Imperial forces stumbled on Azadi's hideout, a brief skirmish broke out when the other crew of the ''Ghost'' arrived. During the skirmish, Chopper secured the ''Phantom'' by entering the ship's astromech socket and piloting it into the ''Ghost''. Later, the ''Phantom'' was used during a [[Mission on Lothal|successful operation]] by the crew of the ''Ghost'' to steal three [[Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvette|''Sphyrna''-class Hammerhead corvettes]] from an Imperial depot in Jalath. The [[Alderaan]]ian [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] had sent three Hammerhead corvettes to augment the Phoenix rebels' depleted forces. Since the Alderaanians could not afford to be seen directly supporting the rebels, Bail instead arranged for his adopted daughter [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] to deliver the ships to Lothal, where they would be "stolen" by the crew of the ''Ghost''. However, the Imperial [[Supply Master]] [[Yogar Lyste]] had fastened [[gravity lock]]s to the ships in order to deter thefts.{{Rebels|A Princess on Lothal}} With the connivance of Leia and Ryder Azadi, the rebels put their plans into action. Donning Imperial uniforms, Kanan and Ezra accompanied Leia back to the Imperial depot in the ''Phantom''. Upon landing, Kanan claimed that they were Imperial personnel who had rescued Leia from the rebels. While Lyste and his stormtroopers were distracted, the other rebels disabled the gravity locks and stole the Hammerhead corvettes. After completing their mission, Chopper and Ezra escaped Lothal aboard the ''Phantom'' and returned with the ''Ghost'' to the rebel fleet, which was waiting on the outskirts of the [[Lothal system]]. ===Ferrying the rebels=== [[File:Fenn_Rau_captured.png|thumb|250px|Kanan captures Rau the ''Phantom'']] The ''Phantom'' was also used by Kanan, Chopper, and Sabine during a [[Mission to the third moon of Concord Dawn|sabotage mission]] to the [[Third moon of Concord Dawn|third moon]] of [[Concord Dawn]]. Earlier, the rebels had attempted to negotiate safe passage through the [[Concord Dawn system]] with the [[Journeyman Protector|Mandalorian Protectors]], a [[Mandalorian]] faction that had colonized Concord Dawn. However, the Protectors' leader [[Fenn Rau]] had allied his people with the Imperials and [[Dogfight over Concord Dawn|attacked]] the rebel diplomatic mission, seriously wounding Hera. In retaliation, the rebels decided to destroy the Protectors' [[Fang-class Protectorate fighter|Fang fighters]], which were housed at a [[Protectors Camp|base]] on the third moon of Concord Dawn.{{Rebels|The Protector of Concord Dawn}} During the mission, Chopper flew the ''Phantom'' into the moon's atmosphere and landed Kanan and Sabine near the encampment. He then flew the shuttle away from the base to avoid drawing the attention of the Mandalorians. After Sabine had succeeded in destroying seven of the Fang fighters, she contacted Chopper to pick them up with the ''Ghost''. Chopper picked up Sabine before rendezvousing the ''Phantom'' with Kanan in the upper atmosphere. Kanan had hijacked Rau's starfighter and managed to knock him out. The Jedi then leaped into the ''Phantom''{{'s}} rear hatchway with Rau in tow. Having completed their mission and take Rau prisoner, the ''Phantom'' then returned to the rebel fleet. Following his capture, Rau allowed the rebels to travel through the Concord Dawn system in exchange for keeping his capture a secret from the Empire. During the crew of the ''Ghost''{{'s}} [[Rediscovery of Lira San|journey]] to [[Lira San]], the ''Phantom'' remained in its mother ship's rear section for much of the expedition. After the rebels rediscovered Lira San, Zeb and the two Lasat refugees [[Gron]] and [[Chava]] used the ''Phantom'' to travel to Lira San's surface. There, they discovered that Lira San was the original Lasat homeworld and that it was already home to millions of Lasat. While Gron and Chava chose to remain on Lira San, Zeb returned on the ''Phantom'' to rejoin his rebel companions aboard the ''Ghost''.{{Rebels|Legends of the Lasat}} With its mother ship the ''Ghost'' low on fuel and power, the crew of the ''Ghost'' took part in a [[Heist at the Asteroid Belt Gas Refinery|heist]] at a [[Mining Guild]] [[Asteroid Belt Gas Refinery]] to obtain fuel for their ship and the fleet. Since the ''Ghost'' was low on power, Captain Hera was forced to divert power from the ''Phantom'' to power the rest of the ship. As a result, the ''Phantom'' remained aboard the ''Ghost'' during the raid. The rebels managed to acquire the fuel canisters and destroy the gas refinery with the help of the [[purrgil]], large space-dwelling creatures capable of hyperspace travel.{{Rebels|The Call}} Later, the ''Phantom'' was used by Kanan and Ezra to search for Zeb following an [[Ambush on an Imperial construction module|ambush]] on an [[ICM-092792|Imperial construction module]] above the planet [[Geonosis]]. Despite their efforts, they were unable to locate Zeb, who had landed with Agent Kallus in an escape pod on the icy moon of [[Bahryn]]. There, Zeb and Kallus overcame their animosity and struck an unlikely friendship to survive the cold and to ward off several [[bonzami]] beasts. After fixing his [[Escape pod transponder|transponder]], the rebels were able to trace his signal to Bahryn where they picked him up.{{Rebels|The Honorable Ones}} Chopper, Kanan, and Ezra later traveled on the ''Phantom'' to scout the planet [[Oosalon]] as a prospective location for a new rebel base. While Kanan and Ezra explored the planet, Chopper stayed in the air with the ''Phantom''. After Kanan and Ezra encountered trouble with the Fifth Brother and the Seventh Sister, Chopper rendezvoused with the Jedis' tibidee and picked them up. To avoid drawing the Inquisitors to the fleet, Kanan instructed Hera to rendezvous with them in deep space. While the ''Phantom'' docked with the ''Ghost''{{'s}} rear, Kanan briefed the other crew and Tano about their problems on Oosalon.{{Rebels|Shroud of Darkness}} Later, Chopper used the ''Phantom'' to ferry Kanan, Ezra, and Ahsoka to the Jedi Temple on Lothal. While the three Jedi entered the Temple, Chopper stayed with the ''Phantom''. When night fell, Chopper picked up some approaching starships on his satellite and departed on the ''Phantom''. Shortly later, the Fifth Brother and Seventh Sister arrived on their [[TIE/ad v1]] [[starfighter]]s. After the Jedi had finished communing with [[Yoda]] and [[the Force]] in the Temple, they returned to the ''Phantom'' and fled into space before more Imperial reinforcements could arrive. [[File:Sabine_vs_spider_creature.png|thumb|250px|Sabine fighting off a krykna on the ''Phantom'']] Following the discovery of the planet [[Atollon]], the Phoenix rebels established a base called [[Chopper Base]] on the planet. After the disappearance of [[Lieutenant]] [[Dicer]], Rex and Sabine took the ''Phantom'' to the base's northern perimeter to investigate. Shortly later, they were attacked by several large spidery creatures known as [[krykna]]. One of the krykna managed to swarm the ''Phantom''. Sabine managed to fight the krykna but Rex was taken captive. After reinforcements arrived in the form of the ''Ghost'', Chopper secured the ''Phantom'' and parked it back in the rear compartment of the ''Ghost''. Following a skirmish, the ''Phantom'' and its mother ship escaped back to Chopper Base.{{Rebels|The Mystery of Chopper Base}} [[File:AhsokaKananandEzraarriveonMalachor.png|thumb|250px|The ''Phantom'' on Malachor.]] The ''Phantom'' was used by Kanan, Ezra, and Ahsoka during their [[Mission to Malachor|mission]] to [[Malachor]] to seek knowledge on how to defeat the [[Sith]]. During the expedition, Chopper served as the ship's pilot from his astromech socket. After landing the Jedi and Tano, Chopper used the ''Phantom'' to track down a second [[starship]] under Kanan's orders. This starship turned out to be a [[Eighth Brother's TIE fighter|TIE/ad v1]] fighter which belonged to the [[Eighth Brother]], another Inquisitor who had attacked the Jedi and Tano. Prior to the [[Malachor Sith Temple]]'s destruction, Chopper used the ''Phantom'' to evacuate Ezra and Kanan. However, the Jedi were unable to bring Ahsoka with them, who was trapped with her former Jedi mentor Darth Vader inside the doomed temple. The ''Phantom'' safely landed at Chopper Base where her passengers were greeted by the Spectres and Rex.{{Rebels|Twilight of the Apprentice}} ===Last mission=== [[File:ThePhantomDestroyed-StepsIntoShadow.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Phantom is destroyed at Reklam Station.]] After [[Rescue of Hondo Ohnaka|rescuing]] Hondo Ohnaka from the [[Naraka prison|Imperial prison]] on [[Naraka]], Ezra, Sabine, Zeb, Chopper, Rex, and Hondo [[Mission to Reklam Station|traveled]] on the ''Phantom'' to the Imperial junkyard [[Reklam Station]], which lay inside the [[gas]] planet of [[Yarma]]. On the way, Sabine and Chopper exited hyperspace at [[Sereeda Waypoint]]. There, they were intercepted by a Mining Guild patrol which ordered them to halt and explain their breach into Mining Guild space. After Chopper and Sabine shot down two [[TIE/mg Mining Guild starfighter]]s, the ''Phantom'' jumped into hyperspace and reached Yarma. With Hondo serving as a guide, the rebels flew inside Yarma's gassy [[atmosphere]] and found Reklam Station. On the way, they were attacked by two [[DTS-series dismantler droid|DTS-series Dismantler Droids]], but Chopper and Rex repelled them. During the dogfight, the ''Phantom'' was damaged, but Sabine managed to regain control. She docked the ship underneath a floating platform at Reklam Station. The rebels then infiltrated the station and managed to steal the [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber|Y-Wing]] light bombers with the help of the [[Ugnaught]] laborers. The ''Phantom'' was destroyed after Ezra shut down power to the station, causing Reklam Station to crash into Yarma's surface. Ezra attempted to escape on the ''Phantom'', but before he could get to it, the platform it was hanging on fell into the volatile surface below and exploded. Ezra was later rescued by Hera and Kanan aboard the ''Ghost''. Hera reprimanded Ezra for his recklessness and for the loss of the ''Phantom''. Due to his actions, Ezra was suspended from his position as [[Lieutenant Commander]]. During a [[Mission to Agamar (2 BBY)|mission]] to [[Agamar]], Ezra, Chopper, Rex, Kanan, and Zeb escaped from the Empire on a [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle]], which became the new ''Phantom'', named the ''[[Phantom II]]'', replacing the one lost at Reklam Station.{{Rebels|The Last Battle}} ==Behind the scenes== The ''Ghost''{{'s}} attack shuttle was first identified as the ''Wolf'' in concept art that appeared in a video released on [[October 12]], [[2013]]. The video featured concept art from the upcoming animated series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''.{{SWYouTube|NX1uCXVg9ug|The Empire Returns | Star Wars
